# SIR в сетях Петри: базовый прогон
Детерминированная (ОДУ) и стохастическая (Гиллеспи) симуляции.

```{julia}
import Pkg
Pkg.activate("/home/dabakharev/work/study/2026-1/2026-1==study-simulation-modeling/2026-1-study-simulation-modeling/labs/lab06/project")
using DrWatson

using Random
include("/home/dabakharev/work/study/2026-1/2026-1==study-simulation-modeling/2026-1-study-simulation-modeling/labs/lab06/project/src/SIRPetri_flat.jl")
using DataFrames, CSV, Plots

ENV["GKSwstype"] = "100"

script_name = "sirpetri_run"
mkpath(plotsdir(script_name))
mkpath(datadir(script_name))

β = 0.3
γ = 0.1
tmax = 100.0

net, u0, states = build_sir_network(β, γ)
```

## Детерминированная симуляция

```{julia}
df_det = simulate_deterministic(net, u0, (0.0, tmax), saveat=0.5, rates=[β, γ])
CSV.write(datadir(script_name, "sir_det.csv"), df_det)
```

## Стохастическая симуляция

```{julia}
Random.seed!(123)
df_stoch = simulate_stochastic(net, u0, (0.0, tmax), rates=[β, γ])
CSV.write(datadir(script_name, "sir_stoch.csv"), df_stoch)
```

## Графики

```{julia}
p_det = plot_sir(df_det)
savefig(plotsdir(script_name, "sir_det_dynamics.png"))

p_stoch = plot_sir(df_stoch)
savefig(plotsdir(script_name, "sir_stoch_dynamics.png"))

println("Базовый прогон завершён.")
```
